purpose: Record the underside appearance, rim variation and trapped insert support on the completed wider-band coupon.
underside_observation: Derek reports improved finish and would likely accept the underside on its own.
edge_observation: Photos show repeated waves along the outer rim. Derek associates the high spots with tree contacts and the low spots with the spans between them.
insert_observation: Tree stems break off and stay inside the heat-insert recesses.
operator_quotes: So on this latest print, the bottom surface is looking better. This is improved, and I am pleased with progress here.
Basically wherever a tree was, it's pushed up into the print.
They break off and they're stuck in there.
requested_followup: Support the rim with segmented fins under the same dense interface as the trees. Bridge each insert recess with no support inside.
